# Muhammad Zeeshan — AI Systems Consulting

> Independent AI systems consultant based in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. One 30-minute call to see where AI fits in your business, what it is worth in hours and cost, and whether it is worth doing. Fixed-fee, independent, no vendor kickbacks.

## About

Muhammad Zeeshan runs an independent AI systems consulting practice in Dubai, UAE. Nine years inside enterprise software, on the teams that built these systems rather than just selling them. Founder of Alvara, an AI-native personal finance assistant built in the UAE. The person on the discovery call is the person who does the work.

## What is offered

- Discovery call: a free 30-minute conversation about how one process runs today, covering where AI fits, what it is worth, and whether it is worth doing. No preparation and no obligation. It can end in "not yet."
- AI Process Audit: a two-week audit of a business's three heaviest processes, delivering benchmarked hours and cost, a prioritized automation roadmap, and a fixed-fee quote per roadmap item.
- Fixed-fee implementation and a monthly care retainer follow only when the numbers argue for them.

## Principles

- Independent: no vendor pays for a place on the roadmap. Tools are recommended only if they fit the work.
- Honest: every engagement can end in "not yet," and nothing is scoped or sold before the call.
- Human: the goal is returning hours lost to work below anyone's skill level, not cutting jobs.
- Fixed-fee, never hourly.

## Who it is for

Dubai and UAE small and mid-sized businesses, roughly 10 to 200 staff, in operations-heavy sectors.
